scope: T2 nested-Incus golden: an overlay of the base golden, dedicated and disposable; Incus runs only inside twins booted from it; no shared Incus/Kubernetes/tunnel/deploy state
recipe: for c in virglrenderer2 libvirglrenderer1; do apt-cache show "$c" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^Package:' && echo "$c" > /run/parity-incus-optional && break; done; true

curl -fsSL https://pkgs.zabbly.com/key.asc -o /tmp/zabbly.asc && grep -q 'BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK' /tmp/zabbly.asc && install -m 0644 /tmp/zabbly.asc /etc/apt/keyrings/zabbly.asc && rm /tmp/zabbly.asc

printf 'Enabled: yes
Types: deb
URIs: https://pkgs.zabbly.com/incus/stable
Suites: %s
Components: main
Architectures: %s
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/zabbly.asc
' "$(. /etc/os-release && echo $VERSION_CODENAME)" "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" > /tmp/zabbly.sources && install -m 0644 /tmp/zabbly.sources /etc/apt/sources.list.d/zabbly-incus.sources && rm /tmp/zabbly.sources
incus storage create default btrfs size=24GiB
incus network create incusbr0 ipv4.address=10.0.100.1/24 ipv4.nat=true ipv6.address=none
incus profile device add default root disk path=/ pool=default
incus profile device add default eth0 nic nictype=bridged parent=incusbr0 name=eth0
incus image copy images:ubuntu/24.04 local: --alias parity-noble
incus image copy images:ubuntu/24.04 local: --vm --alias parity-noble-vm

printf '%s' '[Unit]
Description=Opute killable workload slice (opute-host-resource-policy.v2)

[Slice]
MemoryHigh=10G
MemoryMax=11G
MemorySwapMax=1G
CPUQuota=600%
CPUWeight=100
TasksMax=4096
' > /etc/systemd/system/opute-workload.slice && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl add-wants multi-user.target opute-workload.slice && systemctl start opute-workload.slice
